items.title: Security scan of the kasvimuseo app: login, authorization, uploads, templates, settings and dependencies

checks.command: r=$(git show 2604d5bac88cbb617974f3a6833d70d3cef02545:docs/reviews/2026-10-25-security-review.md) && for h in '## Urgent' '## Findings at a glance' '## Findings' '## Recheck of the deployment review' '## History and local files' '## Dependencies' '## Coverage by area' '### Authentication and the development login' '### Authorization' '### Uploads and image handling' '### Templates' '### CSRF, raw SQL, redirects and error pages' '### Settings that reach production' '### Dependency versions' '## Not reviewed' '## Do these first' '## Draft issues'; do grep -qxF "$h" <<<"$r" || { echo "missing: $h"; exit 1; }; done && test "$(grep '^## ' <<<"$r" | tail -n 2 | tr '\n' '|')" = '## Do these first|## Draft issues|' && echo ok

r=$(git show 2604d5bac88cbb617974f3a6833d70d3cef02545:docs/reviews/2026-10-25-security-review.md) && test "$(grep -cE '^### K[1-8]\. ' <<<"$r")" -eq 8 && test "$(grep -cE '^### KD[12]\. ' <<<"$r")" -eq 2 && grep -qxF '### A1 with additions' <<<"$r" && grep -qxF '### A2 and A3' <<<"$r" && sed -n '/^## Not reviewed$/,/^## Method and limits$/p' <<<"$r" | grep -q grappelli && echo ok

test "$(git diff --name-only 3d3345effaba568e43ef24916f8cf984132f6c14 2604d5bac88cbb617974f3a6833d70d3cef02545 | sort | tr '\n' ' ')" = 'docs/reviews/2026-10-25-security-review.md docs/tasks/20-security-scan-of-the-kasvimuseo-app-login-authorization-uploads-templa.md ' && test "$(git rev-list --reverse 3d3345effaba568e43ef24916f8cf984132f6c14..2604d5bac88cbb617974f3a6833d70d3cef02545 | tr '\n' ' ')" = '907f7ca68195817b5bab40ce58b878cf0397f405 2604d5bac88cbb617974f3a6833d70d3cef02545 ' && echo ok

added=$(git diff 3d3345effaba568e43ef24916f8cf984132f6c14 2604d5bac88cbb617974f3a6833d70d3cef02545 | grep '^+' || true) && test -n "$added" && ! grep -nE '/home/|http://(tinni|atom|hopeli)/|[.]kandev|BEGIN [A-Z ]*PRIVATE KEY|pbkdf2_sha|[$]6[$]|AKIA[0-9A-Z]{16}|gh[pousr]_[A-Za-z0-9]{30,}|ANSIBLE_VAULT' <<<"$added" && echo ok

lock=$(git show 2604d5bac88cbb617974f3a6833d70d3cef02545:requirements/production.txt) && r=$(git show 2604d5bac88cbb617974f3a6833d70d3cef02545:docs/reviews/2026-10-25-security-review.md) && for p in pillow==12.3.0 django==6.0.7 sqlparse==0.5.5; do grep -q "^$p" <<<"$lock" || { echo "lock lacks $p"; exit 1; }; done && grep -q 'Pillow 12.3.0' <<<"$r" && grep -q 'Django 6.0.7' <<<"$r" && grep -q 'sqlparse 0.5.5' <<<"$r" && echo ok

r=$(git show 2604d5bac88cbb617974f3a6833d70d3cef02545:docs/reviews/2026-10-25-security-review.md) && paths=$(sed -nE 's#^\[[^]]+\]: \.\./\.\./([^ ]+)$#\1#p; s#^\[[^]]+\]: \.\./([^ ]+)$#docs/\1#p' <<<"$r" | sed 's#/$##') && test -n "$paths" && while read -r p; do git cat-file -e "2604d5bac88cbb617974f3a6833d70d3cef02545:$p" || { echo "missing: $p"; exit 1; }; done <<<"$paths" && echo ok
